# Setu P2P

> Open-source, strictly serverless, zero-backend WebRTC communication platform running entirely inside the web browser. Provides encrypted one-to-one audio/video calls, screen sharing, remote desktop control, encrypted chat, chunked file transfers, and consensual local recording without accounts, tracking, or central signaling infrastructure.

## Core Architecture
- **Serverless WebRTC:** Executed 100% inside browser runtime. Statically hostable on GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, or any static host.
- **End-to-End Encryption:** DTLS 1.2/1.3 for DataChannels; SRTP (AES-CM 128/256-bit) for audio and video media streams.
- **Peer Identity Verification:** Short Authentication String (SAS) combining DTLS certificate fingerprints into 6-digit confirmation codes and visual verification tokens to prevent Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) attacks.
- **Multi-Modal Signaling:**
  - Manual Non-Trickle ICE: Encrypted Base64 payloads (`SETU-v1:<checksum>:<base64>`) with Adler-32 validation.
  - Visual QR Code: Camera-scanned bidirectional connection exchange.
  - Smart Room Codes: 8-character human-friendly codes (`SETU-XXXX-XXXX`) with automated collision-avoidance probing via ephemeral serverless gateways.

## Key Capabilities & Modules
- **Remote Desktop Control:** Consensual remote input control during screen sharing. Pairs browser WebRTC `control` DataChannel with native Setu Companion daemon over local loopback (`ws://127.0.0.1:49152`). Features pre-shared session passkey auth, normalized float coordinates (`[0.0, 1.0]`), double-cursor suppression, and host physical override supremacy.
- **Audio Notification Engine:** Browser-native Web Audio API synthesizer generating clean, harmonic event chimes for participant join, disconnect, chat messages, and hand-raise alerts without external audio assets.
- **Real-Time DataChannel Chat:** Markdown-enabled chat stored in client-side IndexedDB with optional WebCrypto AES-GCM (256-bit) local passphrase encryption.
- **Chunked File Transfer:** Binary streaming in 64KB chunks with backpressure management, mutual consent prompts, and cryptographic SHA-256 integrity verification.
- **Consensual Local Recording:** In-browser audio/video compositing via `MediaRecorder` and Web Audio mixer. Both participants must grant consent; recordings save directly to local disk.
- **Collaborative Whiteboard:** Interactive shared canvas with explicit host drawing authorization and instant revocation.
- **Privacy Console:** Real-time data audit, configurable retention policies, and one-click Panic Wipe to permanently erase all local storage.

- [System Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Deep-dive architectural specification, subsystem data flows, and state machines.
- [Remote Control Specification](docs/REMOTE_CONTROL.md): Complete daemon architecture, security model, and platform setup for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- [Security & Cryptography](docs/SECURITY.md): Threat models, cryptographic primitives, and mitigation strategies.
- [Privacy Policy](docs/PRIVACY.md): Zero cloud data collection, IndexedDB scoping, and network metadata transparency.
- [Consensual Recording Policy](docs/RECORDING.md): Technical constraints and mutual consent protocols.
- [Deployment Guide](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md): Static deployment instructions for GitHub Pages, Nginx, Caddy, and Vercel.

## Setu Companion (Native Input Daemon)
- Source: `companion/`
- Windows Bundle: `downloads/setu-companion-windows.zip`
- macOS Bundle: `downloads/setu-companion-macos.zip`
- Linux Bundle: `downloads/setu-companion-linux.zip`
- Standalone Node.js Runner: `node companion/setu-companion.js --port 49152 --key "setu_sec_..."`
- Native Rust Build: `cd companion && cargo build --release`
